name: Single-Image 3D Reconstruction Encoder
definition: A convolutional encoder that processes a single input image to produce a latent vector for 3D reconstruction, using standard 2D convolutions.
summary: The Single-Image 3D Reconstruction Encoder is a convolutional neural network that maps a single 2D image to a latent vector for 3D reconstruction, distinguished by its exclusive reliance on standard 2D convolutions without attention mechanisms.
